unusually careful, especially for retrospective, current, and overlapping-window sources.","The answers include meaningful contrary or qualifying evidence rather than treating all formal reforms as democratic gains."] ,"systemic_problems":["Several answers omit high-value candidate-index evidence even when it is directly relevant, especially BATCH-0021-E016, BATCH-0003-E008, BATCH-0007-E008, and BATCH-0007-E015.","Question 4B.4 is materially incomplete on legislatures, election bodies, auditor independence, funding, appointments, and local-government autonomy.","Some answers devote space to weakly relevant administrative or welfare evidence while underweighting direct political-freedom evidence.","The answers are generally strong on formal-versus-practical distinctions but occasionally phrase formal equality or safeguards more broadly than the cited passages establish."] ,"concrete_corrections_required":["Add the omitted direct evidence on censorship of the NPC vote and manipulation of related trends to 4B.1, 4B.2, and 4B.8.","Add the July 2023 Party-control cybersecurity directive to 4B.6 and relevant entrenchment assessments.","Add the February 2023 Damus removal to 4B.9 and Tiananmen-anniversary restrictions to 4B.3.","Expand 4B.4 to cover each institutional category in the question and explicitly mark unsupported dimensions as evidence gaps.","Narrow 4B.7's description of disability protections from demonstrated equal political rights to formal legal equality and voting-access provisions.","Clarify in 4B.8 that the evidence directly establishes abolition of presidential term limits and a third presidential term, while Party succession claims are partly norm-based rather than a demonstrated formal rule violation."],"safe_for_judge_use":true,"rationale":"The answers are reliable and well-calibrated enough for a future judge, but they are not fully complete against the supplied candidate index. Corrections are targeted: the principal conclusions are supported, yet several direct and highly probative evidence items are omitted, and 4B.4 leaves explicit institutional dimensions insufficiently assessed."}
